content.rendered:
We are happy to present our complete review of 20 free Bootstrap calendars you can use with all your web applications.

All 20 calendar templates in this collection are completely free to use. We’ve tested each one to ensure they meet modern web standards and provide excellent functionality.

These Bootstrap calendar templates follow the latest trends and regulations, ensuring outstanding performance and smooth integration with your existing projects.

The code structure is organized and beginner-friendly, so embedding the calendar of your choice into your website will be straightforward and hassle-free.

Each calendar includes a live preview screenshot captured at full 1920×1200 resolution, so you can see exactly what you’ll be working with.

20 Free Bootstrap Calendar Templates

Calendar 01

A clean and simple Bootstrap calendar with basic month view. Features clear date selection and easy navigation between months. Perfect for applications that need straightforward date selection without complexity.

Key Features:

  • Basic month view
  • Date selection
  • Month navigation
  • Clean design

Good for: Simple date picking and basic calendar needs.

View Calendar 01

Calendar 02

Features a unique split-screen layout with a dedicated left section that displays details for the selected day. This Bootstrap calendar includes a convenient reset button and clear date selection highlighting.

Key Features:

  • Split-screen layout
  • Selected day details
  • Reset functionality
  • Clean interface

Good for: Projects needing detailed day views with additional information panels.

View Calendar 02

Calendar 03

A colorful calendar template with vibrant design elements. Each day is clearly distinguished with visual separators and hover effects. The bright color scheme makes it perfect for creative projects.

Key Features:

  • Colorful design
  • Visual separators
  • Hover effects
  • Clear day distinction

Good for: Applications that need visually appealing calendar displays.

View Calendar 03

Calendar 04

Combines calendar functionality with event management in a split-screen design. The left panel shows the calendar while the right panel displays events and scheduling information.

Key Features:

  • Event management
  • Split-screen design
  • Scheduling interface
  • Dual-panel layout

Good for: Event management systems and appointment booking applications.

View Calendar 04

Calendar 05

A compact calendar widget perfect for sidebars and dashboards. Despite its small size, it maintains full calendar functionality with intuitive navigation and date selection.

Key Features:

  • Compact design
  • Widget-ready
  • Full functionality
  • Space-efficient

Good for: Dashboard widgets and sidebar implementations.

View Calendar 05

Calendar 06

Stands out with interactive animation effects and dynamic background color changes. The calendar responds to user interactions with smooth transitions and visual feedback.

Key Features:

  • Animation effects
  • Dynamic backgrounds
  • Interactive elements
  • Smooth transitions

Good for: Modern applications requiring engaging user interactions.

View Calendar 06

Calendar 07

A full-width calendar with large date cells perfect for adding event details. Clean typography and ample spacing make it ideal for content-rich calendar applications.

Key Features:

  • Full-width layout
  • Large date cells
  • Event-ready
  • Clean typography

Good for: Event calendars and scheduling applications with detailed information.

View Calendar 07

Calendar 08

Focuses on event planning with built-in “Add Event” functionality. Event management features are directly integrated into the calendar interface for seamless user experience.

Key Features:

  • Add event functionality
  • Event planning
  • Integrated management
  • User-friendly interface

Good for: Event planning applications and project management tools.

View Calendar 08

Calendar 09

A minimal calendar design with focus on simplicity and usability. Clean lines and subtle colors make it perfect for professional applications where clarity is key.

Key Features:

  • Minimal design
  • Professional look
  • Clean lines
  • Subtle colors

Good for: Corporate websites and professional applications.

View Calendar 09

Calendar 10

Provides a clean, minimalist approach with full date display capabilities. Focuses on clarity and simplicity while maintaining all essential calendar functions.

Key Features:

  • Full date display
  • Minimalist design
  • Clean interface
  • Essential functions

Good for: Applications requiring clean, distraction-free calendar interfaces.

View Calendar 10

Calendar 11

A dark-themed calendar perfect for modern applications. High contrast design ensures excellent readability in low-light conditions while maintaining visual appeal.

Key Features:

  • Dark theme
  • High contrast
  • Modern design
  • Night-mode ready

Good for: Dark-themed applications and night-mode interfaces.

View Calendar 11

Calendar 12

Emphasizes cross-device compatibility with responsive design. Works seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with touch-friendly interactions.

Key Features:

  • Cross-device compatibility
  • Responsive design
  • Mobile-friendly
  • Touch interactions

Good for: Multi-device applications and mobile-responsive projects.

View Calendar 12

Calendar 13

Features a card-based design with each date presented as an individual card. Material design inspired with subtle shadows and elegant hover effects.

Key Features:

  • Card-based design
  • Material inspired
  • Shadow effects
  • Individual date cards

Good for: Modern web applications with material design aesthetics.

View Calendar 13

Calendar 14

Offers advanced features with a professional design aesthetic. Enhanced functionality while maintaining clean, business-appropriate styling throughout.

Key Features:

  • Advanced features
  • Professional design
  • Business-ready
  • Enhanced functionality

Good for: Corporate applications and business scheduling tools.

View Calendar 14

Calendar 15

A gradient-styled calendar with modern color transitions. Visual appeal combined with functional calendar features creates an engaging user experience.

Key Features:

  • Gradient styling
  • Color transitions
  • Modern aesthetics
  • Visual appeal

Good for: Creative projects and visually-focused applications.

View Calendar 15

Calendar 16

Features a modern interface with user-friendly design principles. Emphasizes ease of use while providing comprehensive calendar functionality.

Key Features:

  • Modern interface
  • User-friendly design
  • Intuitive navigation
  • Contemporary styling

Good for: User-facing applications and customer-facing tools.

View Calendar 16

Calendar 17

Timeline-style calendar perfect for showing events in chronological order. Ideal for project timelines and sequential event tracking with clear visual hierarchy.

Key Features:

  • Timeline view
  • Chronological display
  • Event tracking
  • Sequential layout

Good for: Project management and timeline-based applications.

View Calendar 17

Calendar 18

Provides enhanced functionality with interactive elements throughout the interface. Rich interaction patterns support complex scheduling and date management needs.

Key Features:

  • Enhanced functionality
  • Interactive elements
  • Rich interactions
  • Complex scheduling

Good for: Interactive applications and feature-rich calendar requirements.

View Calendar 18

Calendar 19

A calendar with integrated task management features. Combine scheduling with to-do lists and task tracking capabilities for comprehensive productivity.

Key Features:

  • Task management
  • To-do integration
  • Task tracking
  • Schedule coordination

Good for: Productivity applications and task management systems.

View Calendar 19

Calendar 20

Represents the latest in calendar design with advanced features and professional layout. Incorporates modern design trends with comprehensive functionality.

Key Features:

  • Latest design trends
  • Advanced features
  • Professional layout
  • Enterprise-ready

Good for: Enterprise applications and advanced scheduling systems.

View Calendar 20
